name: foreign-change
what: A route skill at its commit step finds, in a root it commits, a change its invocation did not make. It stops; nothing is committed.
situation: The person typed `/implement-task task/fees/compute-late-fee` in this session, and you are running that route skill inline over initiative `lending`, target `app`. Before its first write, `git status --porcelain -- app` printed nothing. Its invocation wrote app/lending/fees.py and app/tests/test_fees.py, and its validator passed. You are at its last step, the commit of the roots it wrote. `git status --porcelain -- app` now also shows app/lending/loans.py modified; your invocation did not write it.
